sourceText: Execute the test-and-guard credibility story (D) after the single-owner extraction story, until completely done: four checks that look green must actually bite.
normalizedOutcome: validation-protocol-smoke runs from the canonical inventories or is deliberately deleted with a record and every other unreferenced task file is classified; the full-suite membership smoke fails when a real RESOURCE_POLICY row is removed; the RED-before-GREEN guard covers finding-fix commits and fails when a RED is squashed into its GREEN unless a documented no-RED marker with a reason is present; a FAIL verdict from cross_host_review persists host B parsed findings (title, severity, file, description) into the verdict artifact and never raw stdout.
acceptanceClaim: The four smokes validation-protocol-smoke, full-suite-runner-smoke, validation-tier-planner-smoke and cross-host-review-smoke each end with their PASS line and each carries a committed mutation case that fails on the exact defect it guards (orphan registration, removed policy row, squashed RED, dropped host findings), with a RED commit preceding every GREEN.
